meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后，这台助手会在你指定的聊天组里按 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式搭建一个持久维基知识库：先建好 wiki 目录、索引与日志，并写入“逐文件处理”的维护纪律。之后收到链接或文件，它一次只处理一个、完整读完再更新维基页面，并可安排定期检查。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等触发词，或要求给某个聊天组添加知识库时，它会启动搭建流程。

say.text: 给当前聊天组建一个 wiki 知识库。
say.note: 它会先让你确认群组和主题，再开始搭建。

say.text: 把这个网页全文存进 wiki，不要只给摘要。
say.note: 它会下载完整内容，并新增或更新对应维基页。

say.text: 每周给 wiki 做一次整理检查。
say.note: 它会确认周期，然后安排定时检查任务。

howto.what_en: Once installed, the assistant follows Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern and becomes a persistent wiki maintainer for the chosen chat group: it creates wiki folder, index and log, enforces one-at-a-time ingestion. It reads links or files fully and updates pages; can schedule periodic checks.
howto.when_en: When you say trigger phrases such as “add wiki”, “wiki”, “knowledge base”, or ask to add a knowledge base to a chat group, it starts the setup.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to the current group.
say_en.note: It will confirm the group and topic, then start building.

say_en.text: Save this webpage's full text into the wiki, not just a summary.
say_en.note: It downloads the full page and updates the wiki entries.

say_en.text: Run a weekly wiki health check.
say_en.note: It will confirm the cadence and schedule the lint task.
